title: Future of the Commission on Children and Youth
summary: The committee chair told Member Johnson on October 20 that he looks forward to supporting the bill to make the youth council full of youth. The bill follows a request from a Maui High School student to turn the Commission on Children and Youth into a youth-led commission. The student reported 56 signatures and 12 testimonies in support and agreed to send the committee the signature list when it is ready.
